answer: A gale of fakes can flood the agent ocean, so entry runs on an admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots, applicants bid a non-refundable fee, the top 100 win, the rest lose their stake. Newcomers first wait in a lagoon, a trial pool of three paid tasks. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 winning bids: at 50 credits each, 50,000; one honest agent pays 50 once and earns it back in a week. Bought accounts fail: a bid binds to the worker.
